doc: T5EncoderModel (the encoder of any T5 / mT5 / T5 v1.1 / Flan-T5 checkpoint used alone: the text encoder of Flux, Stable Diffusion 3, PixArt, Wan, Sana): the T5 encoder stack of the `t5` adapter and nothing else — no decoder, no head; the final-normed rows are the output (`i32` rows at a calibrated power-of-two unit). The class binds the padded source and its count. Features: ENCDEC_FROM_SPEC_V1, OUTPUT_ROWS_V1.
